reason: Provides AI-controlled desktop automation through screen observation, virtual pointer actions, keyboard input, scrolling, dragging, waiting, and application launch tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供屏幕观察、虚拟鼠标操作、键盘输入及桌面应用启动能力，以自动执行电脑操作。
summaries.en: Adds desktop computer-use automation to DeepSeek Harness through screen observation, virtual pointer actions, keyboard input, and application launching.

capabilities: Screen observation via accessibility trees and optional visual fallback
Virtual mouse clicking, double-clicking, right-clicking, dragging, scrolling, and text input
Keyboard shortcuts and key presses in the foreground application
